name: Influential
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 17
body:
Drawbacks
Influential
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 17
Category Faction
When you make a suggestion, strangers often assume that it was their idea to begin with. You gain a +3 bonus on Diplomacy checks to make requests of a creature. Once per day, you may select one single spell you are casting with the language dependent descriptor; you increase the saving throw DC of that spell by 1.
